newsitem.title: UK: Queen Elizabeth I's seal purse found in trunk.
newsitem.headline: Queen Elizabeth I's seal purse found in trunk.

text.p: The 16th century velvet purse in which Queen Elizabeth's Great Seal of state was kept has been found in a storeroom trunk.

"As soon as i saw it, I thought "That's it, that's Elizabeth I's Seal Purse. I knew exactly, I was so very excited,'" Sotheby's textile specialist Kerry Taylor told the Times newspaper after the discovery in a widow's cluttered house.
The sumptuously embroidered purse that contained the symbol of the monarch's legal power is expected to fetch up to 30,000 pounds ($48,500) when put up for sale by the auctioneers in March.
The eldery woman, whose family had owned the purse for decades, had no idea of its value before she died in November.
